delivered just 4% sequential topline growth in the second quarter has led some to view the company’s third-quarter guidance of 7% to 8% sequential growth as too aggressive.

The brokerage called that concern "misguided," noting that the second quarter is often the slowest-growth quarter of the year and that the period did not benefit from an Axon model improvement introduced in July.
